title: USFDA Extends Review of Vertex's Kidney Disease Drug Povetacicept by 3 Months

contentHtml:
Bengaluru: Vertex Pharmaceuticals said on Wednesday the US Food and Drug Administration has extended its review of the company's kidney disease drug by up to three months.

"The extension relates to an information request from the FDA towards the end of the review cycle, to which Vertex promptly responded," the company said. Its shares were down more than 6% in extended trading.

Vertex is seeking approval for its experimental drug povetacicept to treat immunoglobulin A nephropathy, or IgAN, a chronic kidney disease caused by the buildup of antibodies in the kidneys.

The health regulator will decide on povetacicept no later than February 28, 2027, versus its previous target date of November 30, 2026.

Vertex said the agency acknowledged receipt of the requested information, classified it as a major amendment, and indicated it requires more time to complete its review.

Vertex gained access to povetacicept through its $4.9 billion acquisition of Alpine Immune Sciences in 2024.

Povetacicept is designed to block BAFF and APRIL, two immune-system proteins involved in producing disease-causing antibodies.

Source : Reuters
